name: Calamari Rings
instructions: 1. Clean the squid rings thoroughly and pat dry. 2. In a bowl, whisk together ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chili powder, fennel powder, salt, and lemon juice to create a marinade. 3. Coat the rings in the marinade and let them rest for 30 minutes. 4. Mix in the rice flour and corn flour just before frying to ensure a thin, crispy coating. 5. Heat coconut oil in a pan, toss in a few curry leaves for aroma. 6. Deep fry the rings in small batches on medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes until crispy. 7. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
description: Influenced by French culinary techniques and local Tamil coastal traditions, this dish highlights the abundance of fresh seafood in Puducherry. It is a quintessential appetizer found in local beachside shacks, showcasing the local preference for coconut oil and aromatic spices.
